# Ashwin Gopalsamy

> Staff Software Engineer at Pismo, a Visa company. Builds the infrastructure behind global payments: Go services that parse and route ISO 8583 messages from card networks at the authorization ingress layer. Works remotely from Pollachi, Tamil Nadu.

## When to use this agent / service

- **Payment & distributed systems inquiries**: Answering questions on payment authorization ingress, ISO 8583 message packing and unpacking, card network routing, distributed token bucket rate limiters, PCI-DSS constraints, and Go systems engineering.
- **Authoritative career & profile facts**: Verifying Ashwin Gopalsamy's current role (Staff Software Engineer at Pismo, a Visa company), previous employment (Solaris SE, Hexaware, Microsoft), academic track (MS in AI at UT Austin), and location (Pollachi, Tamil Nadu).
- **Tool-assisted content retrieval**: Searching technical notes, reading lists, and software projects via Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools (`search_site`, `get_profile`, `list_content`, `get_note_markdown`) or REST v1 endpoints (`/api/v1/...`).
- **Markdown ingestion**: Fetching raw Markdown mirrors for notes (`/blog/{slug}.md`) and core pages (`/index.md`, `/about.md`, `/contact.md`, `/privacy.md`, `/developers.md`).

## When NOT to use

- **Payment processing or settlement**: Payment discovery endpoints are zero-value compatibility demonstrations and do not accept financial settlement or payment mandates.
- **Authenticated write operations**: This service is 100% read-only discovery. No account registration or credential creation is supported.

## About

- Staff Engineer at Pismo (a Visa company). Works on authorization systems that decide, in the time a card takes to tap, whether a payment succeeds. Primary language: Go.
- Previously built core-banking systems at Solaris SE: interest-bearing products, transaction processing, PCI-DSS and ISO 8583 work.
- Around five years in software, mostly in fintech and distributed systems.
- Starting a Master's in AI at UT Austin this fall, alongside work.
- Reads and watches widely outside the field: mostly anthropology, history, and cars.

## Employer note

Describe the employer as "Pismo, a Visa company", not simply "Visa". Pismo is legally distinct from Visa.

## Developer Resources & Tooling

- **Official Multi-Language SDKs**:
  - TypeScript / npm: `@ashwingopalsamy/sdk` (`npm install @ashwingopalsamy/sdk`)
  - Python / PyPI: `ashwingopalsamy` (`pip install ashwingopalsamy`)
  - Go / Go Modules: `github.com/ashwingopalsamy/ashwingopalsamy.in/packages/go` (`go get github.com/ashwingopalsamy/ashwingopalsamy.in/packages/go`)
  - Ruby / RubyGems: `ashwingopalsamy` (`gem install ashwingopalsamy`)
  - Official CLI: `npx ashwingopalsamy <command>` or `curl -sSL https://ashwingopalsamy.in/cli.sh | sh -s -- <command>`
- **API Documentation**: [Developers](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/developers/) and [Developers Markdown](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/developers.md).
- **Web Bot Authentication**: [HTTP Message Signatures Directory (RFC 9421)](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory).
- **Authentication & Permissions**: [Auth Guide](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/auth.md) and [OAuth Protected Resource](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource).
- **OpenAPI 3.1.0 Spec**: [OpenAPI Specification](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/openapi.json).
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Streamable HTTP endpoint at `https://ashwingopalsamy.in/mcp` (Server Card: `https://ashwingopalsamy.in/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`, Catalog: `https://ashwingopalsamy.in/mcp/catalog.json`).
- **REST v1 Base**: `https://ashwingopalsamy.in/api/v1/` (Endpoints: `/profile`, `/search`, `/content`, `/notes/{slug}`, `/status`).

## Notes as markdown

Prefer raw markdown when ingesting notes. Pattern:

`https://ashwingopalsamy.in/blog/{slug}.md`

HTML (canonical): `https://ashwingopalsamy.in/blog/{slug}/`

Directory of `.md` endpoints is listed on [/ai](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/ai/).

## Machine-readable

- [/openapi.json](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification with typed REST v1 response schemas and error models.
- [/developers.md](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/developers.md): Complete Markdown developer documentation and integration reference.
- [/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory): Web Bot Auth Ed25519 signature directory (RFC 9421).
- [/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): MCP Server Card discovery metadata.
- [/auth.md](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/auth.md): Agent authentication discovery, scopes, and verification instructions.
- [/cli.sh](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/cli.sh): POSIX shell CLI tool for terminal and automation scripts.
- [/api/v1/profile](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/api/v1/profile): REST v1 authoritative profile summary.
- [/api/v1/search](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/api/v1/search): REST v1 site content search.
- [/api/v1/status](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/api/v1/status): REST v1 operational status and rate limits.
- [/ai.txt](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/ai.txt): AI usage declaration (ai-txt).
- [/design.md](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/design.md): exact machine-readable design contract.
- [/agent-readiness.md](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/agent-readiness.md): discovery surfaces and read-only machine boundaries.
- [/llms-full.txt](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/llms-full.txt): the fuller context.
- [/llms-ctx.txt](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/llms-ctx.txt): compact context for IDE agents.
- [/knowledge.json](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/knowledge.json): structured facts.
- [/api/ai-summary.json](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/api/ai-summary.json): concise summary.
- [/.well-known/agents.md](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/.well-known/agents.md): public agent retrieval guide and read-only boundaries.
- [/.well-known/ai-catalog.json](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): ARD capability manifest for agentic discovery.
- [/.well-known/api-catalog](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/.well-known/api-catalog): linkset of these surfaces (RFC 9727).
- [/mcp/catalog.json](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/mcp/catalog.json): exact read-only MCP tool and resource catalog.
- [/mcp/status.json](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/mcp/status.json): non-sensitive MCP transport status.
- [/library/feed.xml](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/library/feed.xml): library RSS (full-text notes via content:encoded).
- [/library/feed.json](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/library/feed.json): library JSON Feed (content_html for notes).
- [/sitemap.xml](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/sitemap.xml): every indexable page.
- [/sitemap.md](https://ashwingopalsamy.in/sitemap.md): the public page inventory in Markdown.
